title: Sherazade's Washington Monuments in Meaning
includes: Includes a professional, knowledgeable guide providing in-depth historical storytelling.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour is an in-depth educational experience of the history and meaning of the monuments. We will begin at the entrance point to the FDR Memorial and conclude at the Lincoln Memorial. This tour is designed as an in-depth discussion on the history of the memorials and Washington D.C. rather than a scenic stop-and-capture tour. It lasts approximately 2.5 - 3 hours and visits the following memorials/ areas:

- President Franklin D Roosevelt (FDR) Memorial
- Tidal Basin with view of the Jefferson Memorial
- Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. (MLK) Memorial
- Korea War Memorial
- Reflection Pool with view of the Washington Monument
- Vietnam War Memorial
- Vietnam's Women's Memorial
- Lincoln Memorial
